breakdown.description: Output requests solution at T=1.1 but the Domain section specifies t in [0, 1].
breakdown.reason: The original prompt specified a time domain of t in [0, 1.0] but requested an output at T=1.1, which is outside the domain. The ground truth resolves this by changing the requested output time to T=1.0. The generated specification correctly identifies this contradiction and consistently uses the final time T=1.0 throughout all instructions, including the time step calculation, the compute instruction, and all output requirements (saving files and printing diagnostics).
